designSummary: Descriptive synthesis of charted data; no pooling.
sampleSize: Not a sample: every eligible report found by the searches is included. The two recorded fixture searches (0 and 7 records) suggest a modest field; the library's preliminary counts will set the screening workload. At about two minutes per title and abstract, 800 records would take about 27 hours of one reviewer's time, which fits the schedule only if full-text screening stays under 80 reports.
primaryAnalysis: Frequency tables and an evidence map of tasks by transition and setting; narrative summary of supervision models; a table of regulatory scope by jurisdiction and date.
secondaryAnalysis: Charted outcome definitions grouped by type; counts of rural and weekend coverage; descriptive comparison of reports with and without competency assessment.
missingData: Items not reported in a source are charted as not reported, never inferred; authors are not contacted within the timeline.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests; all results are descriptive.
software: Reference manager for screening and a spreadsheet charting form with a data dictionary.
overfittingGuards: Charting items fixed after testing on seven records
No effect estimates computed from inconsistent definitions
Unreported items charted as not reported
summary: Descriptive map with no pooling; workload estimated from preliminary counts.
